newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS shares sought in Swiss pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: UBS shares sought in Swiss pre-bourse.

text.p: Shares in Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) were sought in Swiss pre-bourse trading, adding over one percent to 1,301 Swiss francs per bearer share.
Traders said the buying was triggered by follow-up buying after a large block of UBS options was bought by a non-Swiss investor or investors late on Thursday, when the shares closed at 1,287 francs.
Traders said rumours were flying again that UBS planned an acquisition, a cooperation deal or a major restructuring step.

"We do not comment on market rumours as a matter of principle," UBS spokesman Robert Vogler. Vogler noted that rumours often arose shortly before the UBS annual shareholder meeting, scheduled for April 17.

UBS chief executive Mathis Cabiallavetta on Tuesday repeated the bank's already public interest in acquiring an established asset management business in the United States to boost the Swiss group's growth there.
